relationship_note: Urban/building permissions may apply depending on site and works.
Environmental assessment applies only when the project falls under SEIA entry rules.
PAS may apply if the project enters SEIA and a listed sectoral permit is required.
Grid connection route applies where interconnection procedures are triggered.
SEC declarations may apply to electrical installations.
Water rights may be relevant depending on water sourcing.
Hydraulic works permissions may apply to project design.
Telecom authorizations apply only to regulated telecom activities.
Archaeological authorization may be required where interventions affect archaeological heritage.
PAS environmental content is reviewed through SEIA when the permit applies to a submitted project.
Some water-related authorizations can have environmental and sectoral components.
A concession project may independently require environmental assessment.
Heritage authorization may become relevant during project development or works.
Use of maritime/coastal space and environmental assessment are separate regimes that may both apply.
Aquaculture technical approval does not replace environmental assessment when SEIA applies.
Forest authorization does not replace environmental assessment when SEIA applies.
